INSERT INTO stock_levels
                 (id, org_id, stock_item_id, stock_location_id, qty_milli)
               VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
               ON CONFLICT (org_id, stock_item_id, stock_location_id) DO UPDATE
                 SET qty_milli = stock_levels.qty_milli + $5, updated_at = now()
